mapper.sql: r.rsr_id as requestId, r.rsr_appointment_id as appointmentId, r.rsr_company_id as companyId, r.rsr_candidate_id as candidateId, r.rsr_requester_id as requesterId, r.rsr_original_interviewer_id as originalInterviewerId, date_format(r.rsr_original_start, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as originalStartTime, date_format(r.rsr_original_end, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as originalEndTime, date_format(r.rsr_new_start, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as newStartTime, date_format(r.rsr_new_end, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as newEndTime, r.rsr_reason as reason, case r.rsr_status when 0 then 'pending' when 1 then 'approved' when 2 then 'rejected' end as status, r.rsr_reviewer_id as reviewerId, r.rsr_review_note as reviewNote, date_format(r.rsr_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as requestedAt, date_format(r.rsr_reviewed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as reviewedAt, u.nick_name as candidateName, p.pos_title as positionName, iu.nick_name as interviewerName, ru.nick_name as reviewerName

from t_sch_reschedule_request r join t_sch_appointment a on a.apt_id = r.rsr_appointment_id join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.apt_position_id and p.pos_company_id = r.rsr_company_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = r.rsr_candidate_id and t.tal_id = a.apt_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = r.rsr_requester_id left join sys_user iu on iu.user_id = r.rsr_original_interviewer_id left join sys_user ru on ru.user_id = r.rsr_reviewer_id
mapper.select: select rsr_id as requestId from t_sch_reschedule_request where rsr_id = #{requestId} and rsr_company_id = #{companyId} for update

select a.apt_id as appointmentId, a.apt_candidate_id as candidateId, t.tal_user_id as candidateUserId, a.apt_position_id as positionId, p.pos_company_id as companyId, a.apt_status as status, a.apt_interviewer_id as interviewerId, date_format(a.apt_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startTime, date_format(a.apt_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as endTime from t_sch_appointment a join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.apt_candidate_id join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.apt_position_id where a.apt_id = #{appointmentId}
select apt_id from t_sch_appointment where apt_id = #{appointmentId} for update
select count(*) from t_sch_reschedule_request where rsr_appointment_id = #{appointmentId} and rsr_status = 0
mapper.insert: insert into t_sch_reschedule_request (rsr_appointment_id, rsr_company_id, rsr_candidate_id, rsr_requester_id, rsr_original_start, rsr_original_end, rsr_original_interviewer_id, rsr_new_start, rsr_new_end, rsr_reason) values (#{appointmentId}, #{companyId}, #{candidateId}, #{requesterId}, #{originalStartTime}, #{originalEndTime}, #{originalInterviewerId}, #{newStartTime}, #{newEndTime}, #{reason})
mapper.update: update t_sch_reschedule_request set rsr_status = #{status}, rsr_reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, rsr_review_note = #{reviewNote}, rsr_reviewed_at = now() where rsr_id = #{requestId} and rsr_company_id = #{companyId} and rsr_status = 0
